newsitem.title: GERMANY: German neo-Nazis try to mark on Hitler's birthday.
newsitem.headline: German neo-Nazis try to mark on Hitler's birthday.

text.p: Dozens of German neo-Nazis chanting "Sieg Heil" were detained by police overnight after they held gatherings to celebrate Adolf Hitler's 108th birthday in several east German towns, police said on Sunday.
A police spokesman in Eberswalde north of Berlin said the youths were aged between 14 and 24 and some donned swastikas and other Nazi symbols which are banned in Germany.

Police broke up a gathering of eleven youths in a flat in Bernau, a meeting of about 60 rightists at a restaurant in Menkin and a group of 22 neo-Nazis at the railway station in Eberswalde-Joachimsthal.
They confiscated a baseball bat, a knife and a dummy pistol.
Hitler was born in Austria on April 20, 1889.
